description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Weakness +9% Boost (15s)]/[Weakness +15% Boost (15s)]/[Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF10 allies are alive, grants [Awoken Legend], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Fatherly Respect Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Legend
description.text: Dark and Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Weakness +9% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 9% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Fatherly Respect Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Fatherly Respect after using two Dark or Fire abilities

description.name: Fatherly Respect
description.text: One single ranged attack (3.46) capped at 99999, 100% additional critical chance if Tidus is alive
